obligations_en: For differing operand types involving a class, independently test whether each arm can convert to match the other.

Matching an lvalue arm first requires a reference conversion that binds directly. Otherwise, same/derived class operands can match toward the same/base type only without losing cv qualification; that conversion refers to the original object/subobject rather than copying it.
Other matches use the type the target arm has after becoming an rvalue.

Two possible directions, or an ambiguous conversion in the only available direction, make the expression ill-formed. Apply exactly one viable direction; if neither exists, continue with the later conditional-expression rules unchanged.
